en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab narrated to us. Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to us, from Amr ibn Yahya, from Abbas ibn Sahl ibn Sa'd al-Sa'idi, from Abu Humayd. He said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on the expedition to Tabuk. We came to Wadi al-Qura at a woman's garden, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Estimate its produce. We estimated it, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) estimated it at ten awsuq. He said: Count it until we return to you, if Allah wills. We continued until we reached Tabuk. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A strong wind will blow upon you tonight, so none of you should stand in it. Whoever has a camel should tie its tether. A strong wind blew, and a man stood, so the wind carried him and threw him between the two mountains of Tayy. The messenger of Ibn al-Alma, the ruler of Aylah, came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) with a letter and gave him a white mule. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) wrote back to him and gave him a cloak. We then returned until we reached Wadi al-Qura, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) asked the woman about her garden: How much was its produce? She said: Ten awsuq. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am going ahead quickly. Whoever wishes may go quickly with me, and whoever wishes may remain. We went on until Madinah came into view. He said: This is Tabah, and this is Uhud, a mountain that loves us and we love it. Then he said: The best homes of the Ansar are the homes of Banu al-Najjar, then Banu Abd al-Ashhal, then Banu Abd al-Harith ibn al-Khazraj, then Banu Sa'idah, and there is good in all the homes of the Ansar. Sa'd ibn Ubadah caught up with us. Abu Usayd said: Do you not see that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) ranked the homes of the Ansar and placed us last? Sa'd caught up with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said: Messenger of Allah, you ranked the homes of the Ansar and placed us last. He said: Is it not enough for you that you are among the best?
de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab überlieferte uns. Sulayman ibn Bilal überlieferte uns, from Amr ibn Yahya, from Abbas ibn Sahl ibn Sa'd al-Sa'idi, from Abu Humayd. Er sagte: We went out with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) on the expedition to Tabuk. We came to Wadi al-Qura at a woman's garden, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Estimate its produce. We estimated it, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) estimated it at ten awsuq. Er sagte: Count it until we return to you, if Allah wills. We continued until we reached Tabuk. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A strong wind will blow upon you tonight, so none of you should stand in it. Whoever has a camel should tie its tether. We then returned until we reached Wadi al-Qura, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) asked the woman about her garden: How much was its produce? She said: Ten awsuq. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am going ahead quickly. Whoever wishes may go quickly with me, and whoever wishes may remain. We went on until Medina came into view. Then he said: The best homes of the Ansar are the homes of Banu al-Najjar, then Banu Abd al-Ashhal, then Banu Abd al-Harith ibn al-Khazraj, then Banu Sa'idah, and there is good in all the homes of the Ansar. Er sagte: Is it not enough for you that you are among the best? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Affan narrated to us. H; Ishaq ibn Ibrahim informed us. al-Mughirah ibn Salamah al-Makhzumi narrated to us. They both said: Wuhaib narrated to us, from Amr ibn Yahya, with this chain up to the words: There is good in all the homes of the Ansar. It did not mention what followed concerning Sa'd ibn Ubadah. Wuhaib's narration adds: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) wrote to him concerning their sea. It does not say in Wuhaib's narration that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) wrote to him.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Affan überlieferte uns. H; Ishaq ibn Ibrahim berichtete uns. al-Mughirah ibn Salamah al-Makhzumi überlieferte uns. They both said: Wuhaib überlieferte uns, from Amr ibn Yahya, with this chain up to the words: There is good in all the homes of the Ansar. It did not mention what followed concerning Sa'd ibn Ubadah. Wuhaib's narration adds: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) wrote to him concerning their sea. It does not say in Wuhaib's narration that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) wrote to him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Qurrat ibn Khalid narrated to us, from Qatadah. Anas ibn Malik narrated to us. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Uhud is a mountain that loves us and we love it.
de: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Qurrat ibn Khalid überlieferte uns, from Qatadah. Anas ibn Malik überlieferte uns. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Uhud is a Berg that loves us and we love it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar al-Qawariri narrated it to me. Harami ibn Umarah narrated to me. Qurrat narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Anas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) looked at Uhud and said: Uhud is a mountain that loves us and we love it.
de: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar al-Qawariri narrated it to me. Harami ibn Umarah überlieferte mir. Qurrat überlieferte uns, from Qatadah, from Anas. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) looked at Uhud and said: Uhud is a Berg that loves us and we love it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Amr al-Naqid and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, and Amr's wording is used. They said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra, attributing it to the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: Prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers elsewhere, except the Sacred Mosque.
de: Amr al-Naqid and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir, and Amr's wording is used. They said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra, attributing it to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: Prayer in this Moschee of mine is better than one thousand Gebets elsewhere, except the Heilig Mosque. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Rafi and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me. Abd said: He informed us, and Ibn Rafi said: Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers in other mosques, except the Sacred Mosque.
de: Muhammad ibn Rafi and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte mir. Abd said: He berichtete uns, and Ibn Rafi said: Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Prayer in this Moschee of mine is better than one thousand Gebets in other Moschees, except the Heilig Mosque. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me. Isa ibn al-Mundhir al-Himsi narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Harb narrated to us. al-Zubaydi narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and Abu Abd Allah al-Aghar, the freedman of the Juhaynah, who were both companions of Abu Hurayra. They heard Abu Hurayra say: Prayer in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) is better than one thousand prayers in other mosques, except the Sacred Mosque. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) is the last of the prophets, and his mosque is the last of the mosques. Abu Salamah and Abu Abd Allah said: We had no doubt that Abu Hurayra was relating it from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), but we did not ask him to confirm it until Abu Hurayra died. Then we discussed it and regretted not asking him to attribute it to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), if he had heard it from him. While we were in that state, Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim ibn Qariz sat with us and said: I testify that I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am the last of the prophets and my mosque is the last of the mosques.
de: Ishaq ibn Mansur überlieferte mir. Isa ibn al-Mundhir al-Himsi überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Harb überlieferte uns. al-Zubaydi überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and Abu Abd Allah al-Aghar, the freedman of the Juhaynah, who were both companions of Abu Hurayra. They heard Abu Hurayra say: Prayer in the Moschee of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) is better than one thousand Gebets in other Moschees, except the Heilig Mosque. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) is the last of the prophets, and his Moschee is the last of the Moschees. Abu Salamah and Abu Abd Allah said: We had no doubt that Abu Hurayra was relating it from der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), but we did not ask him to confirm it until Abu Hurayra died. Then we discussed it and regretted not asking him to attribute it to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), if he had heard it from him. While we were in that state, Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim ibn Qariz sat with us and said: I testify that I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am the last of the prophets and my Moschee is the last of the Moschees. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us, both from al-Thaqafi. Ibn al-Muthanna said: Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us. He said: I heard Yahya ibn Sa'id say: I asked Abu Salih whether he had heard Abu Hurayra mention the virtue of prayer in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He said: No, but Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim ibn Qariz informed me that he heard Abu Hurayra relate that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers, or like one thousand prayers, in other mosques, except if it is the Sacred Mosque.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns, both from al-Thaqafi. Ibn al-Muthanna said: Abd al-Wahhab überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I heard Yahya ibn Sa'id say: I asked Abu Salih whether he had heard Abu Hurayra mention the virtue of Gebet in the Moschee of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). Er sagte: No, but Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim ibn Qariz berichtete mir that he heard Abu Hurayra relate that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Prayer in this Moschee of mine is better than one thousand Gebets, or like one thousand Gebets, in other Moschees, except if it is the Heilig Mosque. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb, Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id, and Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated it to me. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, with this chain.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb, Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id, and Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated it to me. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, überlieferte uns, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, with this chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah. Nafi informed me, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: Prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers elsewhere, except the Sacred Mosque.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah. Nafi berichtete mir, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: Prayer in this Moschee of mine is better than one thousand Gebets elsewhere, except the Heilig Mosque. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah narrated to us. H; Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. H; Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us. All of them narrated from Ubayd Allah, with this chain.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah überlieferte uns. H; Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. H; Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abd al-Wahhab überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Ubayd Allah, with this chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibrahim ibn Musa narrated to me. Ibn Abi Za'idah informed us, from Musa al-Juhani, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say the same.
de: Ibrahim ibn Musa überlieferte mir. Ibn Abi Za'idah berichtete uns, from Musa al-Juhani, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say the same. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated it to us. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar informed us, from Ayyub, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.
de: Ibn Abi Umar narrated it to us. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from Ayyub, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Rumh narrated to us, both from al-Layth ibn Sa'd. Qutaybah said: Layth narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibrahim ibn Abd Allah ibn Ma'bad, from Ibn Abbas. He said: A woman became ill and said: If Allah heals me, I will go out and pray in Bayt al-Maqdis. She recovered and prepared to leave. Maymunah, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), came to greet her, and she told her this. Maymunah said: Sit and eat what you prepared, and pray in the mosque of the Messenger (peace be upon him), for I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Prayer in it is better than one thousand prayers in other mosques, except the mosque of the Ka'bah.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Rumh überlieferte uns, both from al-Layth ibn Sa'd. Qutaybah said: Layth überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Ibrahim ibn Abd Allah ibn Ma'bad, from Ibn Abbas. Er sagte: A woman became ill and said: If Allah heals me, I will go out and pray in Bayt al-Maqdis. She recovered and prepared to leave. Maymunah, the wife of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), came to greet her, and she told her this. Maymunah said: Sit and eat what you prepared, and pray in the Moschee of the Messenger (peace be upon him), for I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Prayer in it is better than one thousand Gebets in other Moschees, except the Moschee of the Ka'bah. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Amr al-Naqid and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us, both from Ibn Uyaynah. Amr said: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id, from Abu Hurayra, attributing it to the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: Journeys should not be undertaken except to three mosques: this mosque of mine, the Sacred Mosque, and al-Aqsa Mosque.
de: Amr al-Naqid and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns, both from Ibn Uyaynah. Amr said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id, from Abu Hurayra, attributing it to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: Journeys should not be undertaken except to three Moschees: this Moschee of mine, the Heilig Mosque, and al-Aqsa Mosque. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abd al-Ala narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, with this chain, except that he said: Journeys are undertaken to three mosques.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abd al-Ala überlieferte uns, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, with this chain, except that he said: Journeys are undertaken to three Moschees. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to us. Ibn Wahb narrated to us. Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far narrated to me that Imran ibn Abi Anas narrated to him that Salman al-Aghar narrated to him that he heard Abu Hurayra report that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Travel is undertaken only to three mosques: the mosque of the Ka'bah, my mosque, and the mosque of Iliya.
de: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli überlieferte uns. Ibn Wahb überlieferte uns. Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far überlieferte mir that Imran ibn Abi Anas narrated to him that Salman al-Aghar narrated to him that he heard Abu Hurayra report that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Travel is undertaken only to three Moschees: the Moschee of the Ka'bah, my Moschee, and the Moschee of Iliya. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Humayd al-Kharrat. He said: I heard Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman say: Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id al-Khudri passed by me. I asked him: How did you hear your father speak about the mosque founded upon piety? He said: My father said: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) in the house of one of his wives and asked: Messenger of Allah, which of the two mosques is the one founded upon piety? He took a handful of pebbles, struck the ground with them, and said: This is your mosque, meaning the mosque of Madinah. I said: I testify that I heard your father say this.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Yahya ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Humayd al-Kharrat. Er sagte: I heard Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman say: Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id al-Khudri passed by me. I asked him: How did you hear your father speak about the Moschee founded upon piety? Er sagte: My father said: I entered upon der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) in the house of one of his wives and asked: Messenger of Allah, which of the two Moschees is the one founded upon piety? He took a handful of pebbles, struck the ground with them, and said: This is your Moschee, meaning the Moschee of Medina. I said: I testify that I heard your father say this. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ash'athi narrated to us. Sa'id said: He informed us, and Abu Bakr said: Hatim ibn Ismail narrated to us, from Humayd, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Sa'id, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning. It does not mention Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id in the chain.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ash'athi überlieferte uns. Sa'id said: He berichtete uns, and Abu Bakr said: Hatim ibn Ismail überlieferte uns, from Humayd, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Sa'id, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. It does not mention Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id in the chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Ja'far Ahmad ibn Mani narrated to us. Ismail ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Ayyub narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to visit Quba riding and walking.
de: Abu Ja'far Ahmad ibn Mani überlieferte uns. Ismail ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns. Ayyub überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) used to visit Quba riding and zu Fuß. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah. H; Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to the mosque of Quba riding and walking and pray two units there. Abu Bakr's narration says: Ibn Numayr said: He prayed two units there.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah. H; Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to the Moschee of Quba riding and zu Fuß and pray two units there. Abu Bakr's narration says: Ibn Numayr said: He prayed two units there. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Yahya narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us. Nafi informed me, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to Quba riding and walking.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Yahya überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns. Nafi berichtete mir, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) used to come to Quba riding and zu Fuß. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Ma'n al-Raqashi, Zayd ibn Yazid al-Thaqafi, a trustworthy Basran, narrated to me. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us, from Ibn Ajlan, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same as Yahya al-Qattan's hadith.
de: Abu Ma'n al-Raqashi, Zayd ibn Yazid al-Thaqafi, a trustworthy Basran, überlieferte mir. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, überlieferte uns, from Ibn Ajlan, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same as Yahya al-Qattan's hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, from Abd Allah ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to Quba riding and walking.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, from Abd Allah ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) used to come to Quba riding and zu Fuß. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr narrated to us. Ibn Ayyub said: Ismail ibn Ja'far narrated to us. Abd Allah ibn Dinar informed me that he heard Abd Allah ibn Umar say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to Quba riding and walking.
de: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr überlieferte uns. Ibn Ayyub said: Ismail ibn Ja'far überlieferte uns. Abd Allah ibn Dinar berichtete mir that he heard Abd Allah ibn Umar say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to Quba riding and zu Fuß. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, that Ibn Umar used to come to Quba every Saturday and say: I saw the Prophet (peace be upon him) come to it every Saturday.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, that Ibn Umar used to come to Quba every Saturday and say: I saw der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) come to it every Saturday. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated it to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, from Abd Allah ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to Quba, meaning every Saturday, riding and walking. Ibn Dinar said: Ibn Umar used to do this.
de: Ibn Abi Umar narrated it to us. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, from Abd Allah ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) used to come to Quba, meaning every Saturday, riding and zu Fuß. Ibn Dinar said: Ibn Umar used to do this. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd Allah ibn Hashim narrated it to me. Waki narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Ibn Dinar, with this chain. He did not mention every Saturday.
de: Abd Allah ibn Hashim narrated it to me. Waki überlieferte uns, from Sufyan, from Ibn Dinar, with this chain. He did not mention every Saturday. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Muhammad ibn al-Ala al-Hamdani narrated to us, all from Abu Muawiyah. Yahya's wording is used. He informed us, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah. He said: I was walking with Abd Allah at Mina when Uthman met him. He stood with him and spoke to him. Uthman said: Abu Abd al-Rahman, should we not marry you to a young girl, perhaps she would remind you of some of what has passed from your life? Abd Allah said: If you say that, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to us: Young men, whoever among you can afford marriage should marry, for it is more effective in lowering the gaze and guarding the private parts. Whoever cannot afford it should fast, for fasting is a protection for him.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Muhammad ibn al-Ala al-Hamdani überlieferte uns, all from Abu Muawiyah. Yahya's wording is used. He berichtete uns, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah. Er sagte: I was zu Fuß with Abd Allah at Mina when Uthman met him. He stood with him and spoke to him. Uthman said: Abu Abd al-Rahman, should we not heiraten you to a jungen girl, perhaps she would remind you of some of what has passed from your life? Abd Allah said: If you say that, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said to us: Young men, whoever among you can afford marriage should heiraten, for it is more effective in lowering the gaze and guarding the private parts. Whoever cannot afford it should fast, for Fasten is a protection for him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Jarir narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah. He said: I was walking with Abd Allah ibn Masud at Mina when Uthman ibn Affan met him and said: Come, Abu Abd al-Rahman. He took him aside, and when Abd Allah saw that he had no need of him, he said to me: Come, Alqamah. I came, and Uthman said to him: Abu Abd al-Rahman, should we not marry you to a young virgin, perhaps she would bring back to you some of what you used to have? Abd Allah said: If you say that. Then he mentioned the same as Abu Muawiyah's hadith.
de: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Jarir überlieferte uns, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah.
